# skycloak_cluster_logs (Data Source)

Recent application logs for a cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "skycloak_cluster_logs" "errors" {
  cluster_id = skycloak_cluster.production.id
  level      = "ERROR"
  limit      = 100
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID.

### Optional

- `level` (String) Filter by log level.
- `limit` (Number) Maximum entries to return.
- `search` (String) Full-text search filter.

### Read-Only

- `logs` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--logs))

<a id="nestedatt--logs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `logs`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) Logger category.
- `level` (String) Log level.
- `message` (String) Log message.
- `source` (String) Producing component.
- `timestamp` (String) Entry time (RFC 3339).
